# Intent Statement: Site Inspection App

## Problem Statement

Safety inspectors at a construction company fill in paper checklists on building sites and retype them at the office, so reports reach site managers days late and some are lost. Most sites are in basements or remote areas with no mobile signal.

## Target Customer

The company's 40 safety inspectors, and the site managers who must act on failed checks.

## Success Metrics

Inspection reports reach the site manager within one hour of the inspector leaving the site, with no lost reports over a 30-day pilot.
